notes: Not automated: [On Play] If your Leader is [Sabo], [Portgas.D.Ace] or [Monkey.D.Luffy], look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 card with a cost of 3 or more and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
